name: waterfall-veiler-champion-hit-opponent-mills-four
notes: Waterfall Veiler (x6jo8zxhl9), seeded on player 1's field (awake), attacks player 2's champion on turn 3 and hits it. Player 2's deck top (after its turn-2 draw took a filler Dungeon Guide): Fluffy Shopkeep, Dungeon Guide, Fairy Whispers, Spirit of Water (the four milled), Charge the Soul (marker: must be the new top card). Pre-fix the generated body milled the opponent with a loop of MZMove(theirDeck-0), so only ONE card was milled (opponent graveyard 1, deck 17).

rulesClauses: On Champion Hit: That opponent puts the top four cards of their deck into their graveyard.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The generated onHitAbilities["x6jo8zxhl9:0"] milled the opponent's top four cards with a loop of MZMove($player, "theirDeck-0", "theirGraveyard"). Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "theirDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped: only the top card was ever milled (live repro: opponent graveyard 1, deck 17). Overridden in GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php with MillCards().
